steering_ledger.verbatim:
Operator steering (context for Stage 1 ranking and Stage 3 grounding, not authorization to write handoffs):

KERNELS / LOW-LEVEL
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 1. llama.cpp PR #33086 (open): CDNA MFMA bf16 builtins take short vectors; LLVM 23 rejects __bf16 fragments for gfx908/gfx90a/gfx942/gfx950. Builds with clang 23.1.6; identical codegen on clang 22; not run on CDNA hardware. Targets gfx90a directly. Value: rocm-kernel-authoring toolchain readiness before any TheRock 10.x / LLVM 23 move; BF16 drafter path (DF2-11-BF16).
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim:
2. llama.cpp PR #33019 (open): split gate/up weight reads in small_k MMVQ; RTX 3060 decode +4.65% to +21.87% on small models, Q8_0 0.00%, Qwen3 8B Q4_K_M +0.03%; reviewer flagged a small_k row-bounds bug in single-token MoE. CUDA-tested; shared MMVQ code compiles for HIP. Value: AutoKernel MMVQ n<=4 route on the 27B and A3B MUL_MAT_ID cells.
   Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules.
   Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
   (Specifically: separate gate/up loops for short rows, the small_k threshold rule, row guarding for partial MoE blocks under wave64.)
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim:
3. llama.cpp PR #32081 (draft): opt-in --batch-invariant via a per-backend proc address that pins one kernel configuration for every batch size, so greedy verify equals single-token decode; tested on Metal and CUDA; performance cost acknowledged, no numbers. Value: GPU-27B-LONGCTX-SECOND-NONDET, Q8IP-DET2-GATE-1, DTREE Pando / devhandoff FUTILITY_HARNESS_NONDET rows.
   Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules.
   Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
   (Specifically: fixed MMQ/MMVQ/FA dispatch across batch sizes, accumulation order, the cost on HIP.)
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim:
4. FlashInfer v0.7.6 release: batch_invariant=True for chunk_gated_delta_rule (class gdn.bf16.c64) and recurrent_kda, same bits across prefill/chunked prefill/decode; seeded per-row top-k/top-p/min-p sampling; GDN/Mamba2 kernels on a caller-owned state pool. SM100/SM103/SM107 only; does not run on gfx90a. Value: determinism lane (kv-cache-program), GDN state handling for DFlash2 replay.
   Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules.
   Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
   (Specifically: fixed GDN chunk size across phases, per-row seed+offset sampling, slot-indexed state pool layout.)
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 5. llama.cpp PR #33077 (open): ggml_vec_exp_f32 wired to the per-platform ggml_v_expf; KDA loops of the GDN op faster than master by 1.5–2.7% (single token) to 3.1–6.5% (multi-token). Runs on the EPYC CPU (KDA path only). Value: Q38FN CPU non-GEMV diagnoses, cpu-decode-roofline-program.
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim:
6. Any-Rate (arXiv 2611.34402): 2–8 bit nested multi-precision from one checkpoint, half-bit steps over 2–4 bits, extended-Hamming bit-planes, one LUT per row; 69% of FP16 accuracy at 2 bits; decode about as fast as existing kernels; up to 27% less energy (LPDDR model); code public. Targets on-device hardware. Value: INF-80 low-bit lane (EXL3 comparisons), KLD gates.
   Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules.
   Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
   (Specifically: bit-plane packing, per-row LUT decode via AVX-512 byte permutes or LDS tables on gfx90a.)

INFERENCE SYSTEMS / HARNESS / POST-TRAINING
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim:
7. DFly2 (arXiv 2611.34776): block-parallel drafter sharing the target's KV cache and sparse-indexer selections; accepts more tokens than DFlash/DSpark (+3.9–10.5% general, +10.0–31.5% long-context/agentic); +62% and +81% throughput at matched per-user speed on two 64K sets (DS-V4.1-Flash). Targets natively sparse models on GPU. Value: INF-50 DFlash2 (KV sharing on full-attention layers), INF-77 DS-V4.1-Flash.
   Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules.
   Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
   (Specifically: drafter-reads-target-KV layout, reuse of a selection made one step early, no drafter cache.)
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim:
8. HSM / HSGD (arXiv 2611.34092): training-only drafter fixes; up to 52.2% higher mean acceptance length than co-trained MTP with a frozen backbone; 48% lower peak training memory than TTT (Qwen3-8B, EAGLE-3); Megatron-LM / ModelOpt code. NVIDIA training stack. Value: INF-50 MTP/DFlash2 head retraining.
   Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules.
   Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
   (Specifically: hidden-state mixing schedule and memory footprint for a single 64 GB MI210 training run.)
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 9. AsymSpec (arXiv 2611.34010): training-free decoupled draft prompts with example solutions; 2.29–4.95x over autoregressive; exact sampling. Hardware-agnostic; needs a separate draft model. Value: INF-50 draft-model mode, orchestrator repeated-task families.
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim:
10. Ostinato (arXiv 2611.11533 v2): static cross-layer GPU expert pool, resident routes on GPU, cold routes on CPU; tool-turn waits 2.5–6.6x lower, sessions 1.36–3.83x faster, 1.81–2.19x over llama.cpp expert cache on 335 GB DS-V4.1-Flash. CUDA consumer GPUs. Value: A3B GPU candidate lane, INF-77, INF-45 NUMA placement.
   Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules.
   Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
   (Specifically: expert residency pool sizing over 64 GB, CPU cold-route GEMV on NPS4, upload dedup on long prefills.)
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim:
11. llama.cpp PR #33068 (open): MTP/DFlash/draft context shares its partner's compute buffers via ggml_backend_sched_share_buffers; about -130 MiB (MTP) and -190 MiB (DFlash2) on RTX 5090 / RTX PRO 6000; single device, one sequence, no pipeline parallelism. Value: served 27B fit bound (62 GiB), Q8-SERVED-DEV-INJECT-1.
   Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules.
   Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
   (Specifically: whether HIP builds hit the same single-device condition.)
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim:
12. llama.cpp PR #30318 (merged 2026-11-25): ON_DEVICE per-sequence state restore now validates headers inside the try block and returns a recoverable error instead of GGML_ASSERT; without it 146/150 models failed the new rf test; tested CPU and CUDA (RTX 4070). Value: Q8-SERVED-CKPT-COPY-1 checkpoint save/restore path.
   Extract: the performance principles themselves — data layout, tiling, wavefront mapping, LDS use, fusion, quant packing and dispatch rules.
   Check: whether each principle works on the MI210 (gfx90a, CDNA2, wave64, 64 KB LDS, no FP8) or the Zen 5 EPYC CPU (AVX-512, NPS4).
   (Specifically: ON_DEVICE reader semantics against the fork's C21 checkpoint path.)
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 13. Partial Routing (arXiv 2611.33402): lead model delegates subtasks to a cheaper worker using trace-derived guidance; ViBench 70.2 -> 78.5 at 19% lower cost (delta 0.75); Terminal-Bench 54% -> 61% at similar cost. Hardware-agnostic. Value: routing-program escalation, review-plane delegation knobs, MemRL trace reuse.
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 14. SkillsBench audit (arXiv 2611.33943): 7,554 trials / 1,421 paired cells; no task-level reduction significant after correction; skill gating +2–3 pp, but shuffled labels give +4–7 pp; no held-out gain. Hardware-agnostic. Value: eval-tower paired_stats / AEI-RERUN-FLIP noise bands, skill-bank gating rigor.
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

steering_ledger.verbatim: 15. CARE-OPD (arXiv 2611.34756): on-policy distillation with prefix replay, confidence gating and hindsight turn allocation; SWE-bench Verified 59.5%, -45% training time, -44% environment actions vs async online OPD. Training-cluster scale. Value: post-training lane for local Qwen agents.
steering_ledger.reason: Ground the source review and proposed filing at Stage 3.

actionable_ledger.action: On an experimental tree compare the current compiler and a clang-23 candidate on gfx90a, verify emitted BF16 MFMA and run a small BF16 correctness smoke only if planning toolchain adoption.

First count reachable fused small-K rows in current MI210 roles; if hit, compare baseline, split only, and split plus inclusive threshold at neighboring K and odd M, with token throughput and output parity.

Reuse op-level batch tests and route receipts on the existing MI210 census, then do one fixed-input Zen5 replay across single and multiple columns for the first divergent op. Preserve the existing full audit-arm gate.

Review the target sampler RNG cursor lifecycle for stable per-request coordinates under permutations, batch resize and slot recycle; borrow a small backend-neutral metamorphic fixture if current tests lack it. Treat state slots as a related pattern for existing restore ownership.

Check model graph and CPU traces for KDA reachability. If reachable, compare scalar versus vector at real prefill/TG shapes with exponent and recurrent-state error/greedy checks; stop once the op cannot explain meaningful end-to-end time.

On an eligible DS41 or Q38FN low-bit lane, use real expert-tensor shapes to compare normalized format bytes, arithmetic correctness and decode/prefill latency to incumbent GGUF, then equal-bytes quality before funding a model port. Keep precision switching a distinct experiment.

Inventory exact artifacts and indexed-KV ABI first; compare replayed index coverage and KV bytes in the DS41 lane without reopening held tests. Promote to served throughput only when paired weights and index custody are available.

Prioritize released boosted checkpoint with compatible format and same serving graph; run early-position and tail acceptance plus latency per chosen K on both devices. If training is required, perform dry-fit accounting and one-step peak reserve check against an explicit margin.

Add one benchmark-only immutable draft-prefix arm to a separate-checkpoint path, with zero-exemplar same-token-budget control, target-only reference, held-out nonleaking exemplars, exact sampled-distribution check and session TTFT/time by cache state. Keep verifier prompt and sampler identical.

Replay small set of saved DS41 route traces as placement + bytes feasibility, independent of held DS41 inference. Measure resident-route fraction, rows per cold expert, dedup ratio and timing estimates for same-placement CPU-only cold, GPU weight upload and mixed execution. If favorable, compare matched upload threshold/loading and parity before porting HIP graph.

Locate scheduler sharing primitive and audit ordering, lifetime, realloc and separate fallback. If concrete MI210 fit is blocked by scratch, prototype under experimental ROCm eligibility and compare achieved peak VRAM, greedy exactness and throughput with overlap controls.

Compare #27530 cleanup prerequisites against an experimental branch and port the minimal defensive guard with the isolation test. Verify valid restore, recoverable invalid restore and unchanged neighboring sequence on Zen5 and actual gfx90a resident state.

Read existing P3 bounded worker traces to freeze task-family groups, failure categories and request-cost attribution. On unseen groups compare same lead alone, plan-only, unguided and profile tiers with the same available lead/worker pair. Log invalid, skipped and failed runs; predeclare minimum quality and latency margin and sample cap, stop if existing traces cannot identify routed spans. No P3 activation decision follows an offline or mock result.

Attach an observational sidecar to the remaining EV-10a paired-mutation A/B: verify normalized effective skill manifests per arm and audit scorer constraints against visible task text, retain paired item outcomes and full denominator. Report within-cell shuffled null, untouched later draws for decisions, and task-family holdout for generalization. Reuse the suite-level gate with diagnostic sidecar output. Stop at a preregistered valid-pair cap or declared precision and do not use aggregate efficacy as evidence of task-level stability.

Use existing HIL-16a source-era clean trace manifests and HIL-12/13 first-visible-deviation labels if joinable. Freeze original trajectories and hold out whole tasks; compare equal-sized evidence-ranked, random and depth-ranked turn lists for externally judged hit rate, late-turn recall and abstentions. Keep confounded or missing cases in denominator. Stop if no independent decision-turn labels or if equal-budget selection offers no material held-out gain. Keep existing four-arm replay acceptance independent of this diagnostic; only a positive diagnostic warrants testing its turn priorities in replay.

Use as companion evidence for the paper. Under INF-80 compare effective bytes and scalar decode on frozen EXL3 fixtures and held-out KLD/model inputs before a single AVX-512 or HIP microbench. Freeze baseline, raw row outputs, invalid denominators, and latency/quality stops.

Apply precommitted held-out policy and within-cell shuffled calibration at any SkillBank promotion. Freeze model/task/harness and thresholds, use disjoint tasks or new trials, archive per-trial decision/reward/graded/invalid/abstention denominators, compare always-load versus gate with existing paired and rerun logic, and predeclare minimum benefit and shuffle separation.

Use as companion to DFly2. For INF-77 pin target/drafter versions and prove read-only released weight/latent/layer/last-accepted-position mappings, estimate gather bytes versus matched-width MTP/DSpark, then gate experimental serving if economics justify it. INF-50 can reuse target context on full-attention layers separately from native sparse index sharing.

For an experimental cache candidate apply discard-before-destruction to owned buffer-reader failure exits and scope hybrid rollback correctly. Gate defensive isolated-state correctness with unaffected calls, preserved-unmodified and removed-modified outcomes across host/device. Q8-SERVED-CKPT-COPY-1 consumes the result and retains its timing gate.

Fold into FlashInfer v0.7.6 action. If current per-op traces isolate GDN cross-phase mismatch, first establish same-bit rows and boundary state on fixed held-out shapes spanning prefill/chunk/decode/span and slot changes with witnessed valid domains. Gate any opt-in candidate against raw A/A, latency and VRAM. Existing RS-REPLAY tests rollback correctness/speed, a separate axis.

Retain the SPEC-RNG.1 DO-NOT-CARRY result. If a named consumer requires same-seed cross-batch replay, first attribute failures by reusing a frozen-logit, same-key fixture with moved slot, batch width and request order. Keep within-stream repeatability and backend logit equality in distinct checks, and preserve the existing serving RNG until a consumer benefit is demonstrated.

Extend the existing SPEC-PIT post-sampling fixture with exact ties just above/below the top-p boundary, filter order, -inf and no-op cases, and compare named support, sampled token and normalized probability against the current served sampler on identical rows/keys. Persist native versus whole-tie results and full-row versus post-filter logprob labels distinctly. Promote a new policy only if a consumer requests it and the same-denominator gate passes.

Census the EPYC DFlash2/recurrent state path for residual state-sized copies versus direct writes and bound bytes/ms on both hardware paths. Reuse existing state controls, keeping a CPU fixture for permuted/noncontiguous slots, null initialization, alias rejection and slot reset/reuse. Only carry a direct-write arm when the current capture identifies a remaining copy boundary and its slot owner can enforce uniqueness and read-before-write lifecycle.

Retain as a design for reversible retirement only when a SkillBank owner proposes a specific existing model/skill pair for suppression. Then freeze behavior-specific task families, verifier and model identity, include untouched-on-policy evaluation and challenge probes with an external witness, preserve abstentions and invalid counts, compare full library versus reversible removal with per-task receipts, and predeclare tolerated regression and restoration conditions. EV-10a still validates mutation efficacy by paired per-suite delta; do not reuse retirement labels as loader efficacy or automatically suppress rules/artifacts.

selection: All recommended dives accepted by operator; up to four sweeps.

stage2_closeout.scope: Selected reference implementations, cleanup prerequisite, filtered and unfiltered sampling, canonical GDN and pooled-state writes. Remaining references discussed in README.
